title: Choose a surface by user intent
summary: Decide whether a page must persuade, support repeated work, teach or showcase before choosing layout density, navigation and visual emphasis.
when_to_use: The brief names a product but leaves the purpose of an individual page or surface unclear.
avoid_when: The user has already pinned a specific existing workflow and visual identity; preserve those constraints.

anatomy.purpose: States what the visitor must decide, complete, understand or inspect.
Defines an observable outcome for that task.
Places the most useful content and action first.
Matches repeated use or linear reading rather than following a generic landing-page template.

responsive: Re-evaluate the task order on mobile instead of merely stacking desktop sections.
accessibility: Keep the primary task visible through semantic headings, landmarks and clear action labels.
implementation_steps: Identify the visitor's task and success signal.
Choose information density and interaction model to fit that task.
Create a structure sketch before visual styling.
